head: 84f3beb57
scope: Remove the duplicate Persona lifecycle, provisioning, transport, projection, and idempotency definitions from bff/main.py; keep their owning service implementations.

composition_before_change.trace: core/app_factory.py mount_bff_routers._dep checks the production main module attribute before fallback_factory and _resolve_default_dependency. On the recorded base, every name below was defined in main.py; where requested through _dep, the main.py object therefore won over the owner-module resolver. This is runtime composition precedence, not AST reference counting.

assertions: All 15 in-scope names are absent from main.py and present in the owning module (list_strategy_summaries is the owner name for the removed main alias).

The test wraps _resolve_default_dependency while calling compose_bff_app, proving that production _dep falls through the missing main.py names to the resolver. The resolver returns the exact persona service objects for the strategy idempotency function and all three idempotency stores; _list_strategy_summaries resolves to a callable backed by strategies.service.list_strategy_summaries.
The freshly composed app's mounted router endpoints and app.state.persona_service.get_provisioning_store resolve to the identical persona service provisioning store instance.
